messages:
carmen: Heads-up from CRO review: customers are confused by the relationship between Min/Max and the SLO slider. They ask: 'Does Max guarantee performance or just normal traffic?' Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EFGH (frame 'capacity/clarify-relationship').

reza: Agree. We should avoid the word 'Max' alone. Suggest label change: 'Max GPUs (autoscaler normal cap)'. Short helper: 'Used for expected traffic; burst may exceed.'

mira: Prefer to keep labels concise on the surface: 'Max GPUs' + helper line below with the phrasing Reza suggested. And add a tiny info link 'How caps & burst work' that opens the docs panel.

alex: Dev note 12: The info link should be a button element for keyboard focus. Also we must ensure any opened docs panel sets focus to its heading and traps focus until dismissed.

sam: UX thought: show a small visual lane that shows three zones: Min | Max (normal) | Burst cap (transient). Use subtle separators and labels. Users found it more intuitive in testing.

carmen: That lane idea is good. Keep it simple: horizontal bar, tick marks at the numeric values, and a legend. No animation needed.

mira: Accessibility: the lane should be exposed with aria-describedby referencing a textual summary for screen readers: 'Range visualization: min 2, max 8, burst cap 12'. Don't rely on color alone.

alex: Implementation plan: add a role=img aria-label="Capacity range" and a visually-hidden text element with the same summary. Also ensure the steppers announce value changes via aria-live polite.

reza: Copy proposals: Helper under Max: 'Autoscaler normal cap 1200used for expected traffic'. Burst tooltip: 'Burst allows short-term scale above Max; extra GPUs billed at higher rate.'

sam: Small UI nit: when Burst is toggled on, the Max control should not disappear. Gray it and add a pill 'Burst active' to indicate state. Hiding controls caused support tickets.

carmen: Agreed. Final action list: 1) Update labels: keep 'Min GPUs'/'Max GPUs' with helper under Max; 2) Add capacity lane viz with accessible description; 3) Add info link to docs panel (keyboard focusable); 4) Gray Max when Burst on, show 'Burst active' pill; 5) Ensure aria-live for stepper changes and live announcements when Burst toggles.

mira: I'll patch Figma and leave comments with exact helper copy and the lane artboard. If you want, I can also add two microcopy variants (short vs verbose) for localization review.

alex: I'll prototype the lane and aria-live strings. Will post a small PR with markup and a demo storybook story for QA.

sam: I'll run a quick keyboard and NVDA check once the story is up. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
